senses.gloss:
अप-सान्त (न्तं) 1.
n. Offering of
water or of sacrifice.

आप (पः) 1.
m. A demigod, a Vasu.

अप-कलङ्क (ङ्कः) 1.
m. Indelible dis-
grace, or stain.

अपकारा_र्थिन् (थी-थिनी-थि)
a. Ma-
licious, wishing evil to.

अपा_कृत (तः-ता-तं)
par. Taken
away; changed; paid.

आप-गा (गा) 1.
f. A river or stream.

अप-घातिन् (ती-तिनी-ति)
a. Strik-
ing, killing, murdering.

अप-च्छाय (यः-या-यं)
a. Shadowless.
(या)
f. A phantom.

अ-पञ्ची_कृत (तं) 1.
n. A simple or
uncompounded substance.

अ-पटा_न्तर (रः-रा-रं)
a. Adjoining,
contiguous, near to.

अ-पटी_क्षेप (पः) 1.
m. Hurried en-
trance on the stage.

अ-पथ (थं) 1.
n. The absence of
a road, a by-way.

अप-थ्य-भुज् (क्)
a. Eating unwhole-
some things.

अ-पद (दः-दा-दी-दं)
a. Footless;
stationless.
adv. Unseasonably.

अप-दान (नं) 1.
n. Approved occu-
pation or work. Also अपदानकं.

अपा_दान (नं) 1.
n. Removal, abla-
tion, taking away.

अप-दिशं (शं)
ind. Intermediate
space from point to point.

अप-देश (शः) 1.
m. Disguise by
dress, evasion; pretext.

अप-ध्वंसज (जः) 1.
m. Man of a
mixed or impure caste.

अप-नय (यः) 1.
m. Taking away,
injury, insult.

अप-नयन (नं)
n. Taking away, re-
moving; dying; acquittance.

अप-नीत (तः-ता-तं)
par. Taken
away, removed; paid.

अप-नुत्ति (त्तिः) 2.
f. Removing.
Also अप-नुदः अप-नोदः अप-नोदनं.

अप-नोदिन् (दी-दिनी-दि)
a. Re-
moving, taking away.

अप-भ्रंश (शः) 1.
m. Ungrammatical
language, low language.

अप-मित (तः-ता-तं)
par. Disrespect-
ed; neglected in dress.

आपमित्यक (कं) 1.
n. Property, &c.
obtained by barter or exchange.

अप-यशस्कर (रः-रा-रं)
a. Disgrace-
ful, causing disgrace.

अपर (रः-रा-रं)
a. Other.
f. The
womb.
n. The hind quarter of
an elephant.

अ-पार (रं) 1.
n. The opposite bank
of a river.
a. Boundless.

अपर-रात्र (त्रः) 1.
m. The end of the
night, the last watch.

अ-परांमुख (खः-खा-खं)
a. Fronting
boldly in time of danger.

अ-पराजित (तः)
m. Shiva; Viṣṇu;
a plant.
a. Unconquered.

अपराद्ध_पृषत्क (त्कः) 1.
m. An archer
or arrow always missing.

अ-पराधीन (नः-ना-नं)
a. Independ-
ent, not subject to another.

अपरा_ह्णतन (नः-ना-नं)
a. Belong-
ing to the afternoon.

अ-परिग्रह (हः) 1.
m. Non-accept-
ance.
a. Independent.

अ-परिचित (तः-ता-तं)
a. Unknown
to, unacquainted with.

अ-परिचेय (यः-या-यं)
a. Unsocia-
ble, not to be known.

अ-परिष्कृत (तः-ता-तं)
a. Unpolish-
ed, coarse, rude.

अ-परिहार्य्य (र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं)
a. Inevita-
ble, not to be avoided.

अ-पर्ण (र्णः-र्णा-र्णं)
a. Leafless.
(र्ण्णा)
f. A name of Pārvati.

अ-पर्य्याय (यः) 1.
m. Want of order,
or method.

अ-पल (लं) 1.
n. A pin or bolt.

अप-लाप (पः) 1.
m. Denial; eva-
sion; secret regard.

अप-लापिन् (पी-पिनी-पि)
n. Deny-
ing or evading.

अ-पलायन (नं) 1.
n. Standing firm,
not retreating.

अप-वर (रः-रकः) 1.
m. An inner
apartment, lying in chamber.

अप-वर्जन (नं) 1.
n. Gift; abandon-
ment; final beatitude.

अप-वर्ज्जित (तः-ता-तं)
par. Aban-
doned, quitted, given up.

अप-वर्त्तन (नं) 1.
n. Taking away, red-
ucing to the lowest terms.

अप-वाह्य (ह्यः-ह्या-ह्यं)
a. To be car-
ried off or borne away.

अप-वाद (दः) 1.
m. Censure; a bell
or pipe used in deer-hunting.

अपविद्ध-पुत्र (त्रः) 1.
m. A rejected
son adopted by a stranger.

अपा_वृत (तः-ता-तं)
a. Self-willed;
covered; opened.
adv. Unre-
servedly.

अपा_वृत्त (त्तः-त्ता-त्तं)
a. Rolling on the
ground; uncovered; repelled.

अप-शब्द (ब्दः) 1.
m. Ungramma-
tical language, vulgar speech.

अप-शोक (कः) 1.
m. A tree (Jone-
sia asoka).

अपश्विम (मः-मा-मं)
a. Chief, not
last; endless.

अप-ष्ट (ष्टं) 1.
n. The point of a
hook for driving elephants.

अप-ष्ठु (ष्ठुः)
m. Time.
a. Contrary;
left.
adv. Well; badly.

अप-सर्जन (नं) 1.
n. A gift; kil-
ling; giving up; abandonment;
final emancipation.

अप-सलवि
ind. Space between the
thumb and forefinger.

अप-सव्य (व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
a. Right (not
left), opposite, contrary.

अप-स्कर (रः) 1.
m. Any part of a
carriage; the anus; fæces.

आपस्कार (रं) 1.
n. Lower part or
extremity of the trunk or body.

अप-स्नान (नं) 1.
n. Funeral bathing
after mourning.

अप-स्पश (शः-शा-शं)
a. Having no
spy; having no explanation.

अप-हानि (निः) 2.
f. Leaving off,
loss, exclusion.

अप-हार (रः) 1.
m. Loss, taking
away; spending; secreting.

अपहृत-ज्ञान (नः-ना-नं)
a. Bereft of
sense, confounded.

अ-पांक्त (क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
a. Excluded from
the row, or class of society.

अपा_ङ्ग (ङ्गं) 1.
n. The outer corner
of the eye.
a. Maimed.

अपा_ङ्गक (कः) 1.
m. A plant (Achy-
ranthes aspera).
a. Maimed.

अपा_ङ्ग-दर्शन (नं) 1.
n. A side-
glance, a side view.

अपा_च्, अपाञ्च् (ङ्-पांची-क्)
a. Sou-
thern, southerly.

अ-पात्र (त्रं) 1.
n. A common, mean
utensil; a worthless person.

अपा_न (नं) 1.
n. The anus; a fart.

आ-पन्न (न्नः-न्ना-न्नं)
a. Obtained; un-
fortunate; acquired.

आ-पान (नः) 1.
m. A place for drink-
ing in society, a tavern.

अपा_मार्ग (गः) 1.
m. A plant (Achy-
ranthes aspera).

अपा_य (यः) 1.
m. Destruction; se-
paration; loss; retreat, flight.

अपा_यिन् (यी-यिनी-यि)
a. Going
away, departing, perishing.

अपार्थ-करण (णं) 1.
n. False plea in
a law suit.

अपा_श्रय (यः) 1.
m. An awning over
a court-yard.
a. Destitute.

अप्प_ति (तिः) 2.
m. A name of Va-
runa.

आ-पणिक (कः) 1.
m. A shopkeeper;
market rate.
a. Mercantile.

आ-पतिक (कः) 1.
m. A hawk.
a.
Accidental, providential.

आपत्-काल (लः) 1.
m. Time of
trouble and distress.

आपत्-कालिक (कः-की-कं)
a. Occur-
ring at a time of calamity.

आपद्-धर्म्म (र्म्मं) 1.
n. A resource
allowable in time of distress.

आपरा_ह्निक (कः-की-कं)
a. Of the
afternoon, after mid-day.

आप-स्तम्ब (म्बः) 1.
m. Name of a sage.

अप-वेध (धः) 1.
m. Piercing and
spoiling (a gem).

अपहृत-विज्ञान (नः-ना-नं)
a. Bereft
of sense, confounded.

अपारणीय (यः-या-यं)
a. Out of reach,
beyond reach.
